chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-'Abbas, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ghiyath, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, from his father, who said:
Nothing is washed with saliva except blood.
ai.seo_question: What can be cleaned with saliva according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning purification from najasah. It states that saliva is not used to wash away anything except blood.
